title: Exploring Causal Effect of Social Bias on Faithfulness Hallucinations in Large Language Models
reasoning: The study includes 'Religion' as one of the five primary categories of social bias evaluated in its benchmarking dataset (BID). Table 1 and Table 3 specifically detail subtypes such as 'idol worship' and 'intolerance' and measure the causal effect of religious bias on LLM hallucinations.
